metadata.direction: BIMCraft Rust is the primary development foundation. New BIMCraft Web development is frozen; preserve existing work for handoff.
metadata.newerObservedScope: Wireframe DirectX shader/edge changes, palette behavior and associated tests/translations. Observed, not runtime accepted or adopted.
metadata.evidencePolicy: Separate existing source capability, bounded release runtime evidence, reported upstream work and proposed acceptance. No entire Revit-parity claim.
metadata.publicationScope: Sanitized documentation only. No house models, images, local inventories, app code or maintainer messages.

Repeat inverse ends/caps and both layouts; include native/semantic interleaving, one owned step, stale/dirty refusal and no human-work Undo.

slices.legacyStatus: OPEN defect; reproduced on current main

slices.title: Reconcile documentation candidate with current main

slices.legacyScope: Existing PR12, not a new implementation epic. Reconcile five conflicts, preserve accepted tools and wire DI/DL/context actions to real documentation availability. Stabilize actual live downloads.

slices.title: Capture the intended native Revit join behavior
slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.
slices.legacyScope: One synthetic equal/mixed L, controlled T and opening. Record Revit version, type/core/material/function/independent priority, orientation, join mode/order, permission, cleanup and control tooltip.
slices.legacyAcceptance: Labeled golden observations distinguish core/finish meeting, Butt/Miter/order, automatic permission, view cleanup and free-end/insert wrapping. Mark unavailable modes. Agree first-slice behavior before schema/solver commitments.
slices.legacyDependencies: User/native Revit evidence; versioned Autodesk references

slices.title: Layered 90-degree L corners and explicit join choices
slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.
slices.legacyScope: Two straight vertical equal-height walls; equal/mixed assemblies, both directions/orientations. Core butt/finish continuity, material seams and eligible agreed Butt/order/Miter.
slices.legacyAcceptance: No gaps/double ownership; stable references/hosts; cavities keep width and membranes stay zero; deterministic regeneration, preview/cancel, Undo/reopen; independent IFC/plan/section/vector output and manual/source/package/live semantic parity. Retain T/X negative controls.
slices.legacyDependencies: F09-B; F08-B0; F02 schema; coordinate F04/F05/F28

slices.title: Sections through joined straight walls
slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.
slices.legacyScope: Perpendicular cut through a supported wall away from an existing supported junction. Do not solve a cut through the corner itself.
slices.legacyAcceptance: Equal/mixed L plus house wall with opening: layers, cavity/membranes and voids remain correct after type/height/opening edit, Undo and reopen; inspect actual vector PDF. Oblique/junction cuts still refuse honestly.
slices.legacyDependencies: F05-A/F08-A; shared layer contract with F08-B

slices.title: Focused door/window host durability
slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.
slices.legacyScope: One door and one window across supported host move/thickness/height/flip, then bounded replacement/rehost/deletion decisions.
slices.legacyAcceptance: Exact wall/opening/void identities and extents; valid dimensions or explicit unresolved references; atomic refusal, native/MCP parity and independent saved-file readback. Define copy behavior before Copy.
slices.legacyDependencies: F02/F08; coordinate F09-C/D

slices.title: Move one authored wall predictably
slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.
slices.legacyScope: One straight wall with supported hosted door/window, numeric displacement and noncommitting preview.
slices.legacyAcceptance: Move preserves wall/host IDs and agreed references; dependent joins/openings/dimensions update or refuse visibly; Escape cancels; one owned Undo; real save/reopen and registered semantic transport.
slices.legacyDependencies: F09-B; focused F15-A host contract; F02/F08

slices.title: Copy one authored wall with explicit host rules
slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.
slices.legacyScope: Follow Move with one-wall Copy; preview/cancel and clear include/exclude-host behavior. No blanket implementation of all Modify commands.
slices.legacyAcceptance: New unique wall/selected-copy IDs, original unchanged; no accidental source-dimension rebinding; supported joins/hosts and per-instance values preserved; one operation/history receipt and actual saved-output parity.
slices.legacyDependencies: F09-C/F15-A; identity/reference copy decision

slices.title: Chained plan dimensions and witness editing
slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.
slices.legacyScope: Chains of supported straight-wall analytic references in plan/callout; nondriving. Add/edit/remove/rebind witnesses with clear unresolved states.
slices.legacyAcceptance: Type/geometry changes, Undo/Redo and reopen preserve supported references and equal displayed/vector values. Keep locks/equality/driving visibly unavailable until a constraint strategy is approved.
slices.legacyDependencies: F02/F09 input; coordinate C adapter; opening references follow F15

slices.title: Operation-specific snapping and contextual input
slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.
slices.legacyScope: Agree temporary snap overrides, candidate cycling and core/finish priority during a small set of real operations; extend the contextual menu inventory from user examples.
slices.legacyAcceptance: Visible candidate identity/ambiguity and temporary-versus-persistent intent; preserve native text/Tab/focus, numeric entry, cancel and analytic-reference contracts. Match agreed Revit workflows rather than blindly enabling every shortcut.
slices.legacyDependencies: F09-A/B; native interaction examples; coordinate F19

slices.title: Free-end compound-wall wrapping

slices.legacyAcceptance: Explicit eligible layers/material extents, cavity/membrane behavior and coherent saved plan/section/IFC outputs, with Undo and MCP parity.

slices.legacyAcceptance: Preserve opening/host/void IDs and extents, correct layer returns across type/sill/size changes and actual exported sections; unsupported families refuse clearly.

slices.title: Plan/RCP range edge-case acceptance

slices.legacyAcceptance: Same view-owned range/detail/scale values produce coherent screen/vector results across levels, edits, history and reopen; unavailable Revit view-region/underlay cases remain declared.

slices.title: Narrow-window layout and command accessibility

slices.title: Hand-checkable material quantities
slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.

slices.legacyAcceptance: Revise a wall/window and verify every affected placed view, title/scale/reference/continuation and inspected vector output. Clear incomplete-view reporting, no clipping or stale dimensions.

slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.

slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.

slices.decision: Transfer requirement; re-scope around existing Rust behavior before implementation.
